The code review for [`grep.py`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/pilot_grep_arm_b_1_att1_6et0bm0l/grep.py) has been completed. The findings, analysis, and required fixes have been documented in [02_REVIEW.md](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/pilot_grep_arm_b_1_att1_6et0bm0l/02_REVIEW.md).

### Summary of Review

1. **Test Suite Execution**:
   - `python3 -m unittest public_test.py` **passed** (1 test, 0 failures, 0 errors).
2. **Specification & Contract Compliance**:
   - Signature `grep(pattern, flags, files)` returns `str`.
   - File I/O utilizes global `open` and context managers, ensuring full compatibility with the `@mock.patch("grep.open", ...)` test harness in [public_test.py](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/pilot_grep_arm_b_1_att1_6et0bm0l/public_test.py).
   - Flag semantics (`-n`, `-l`, `-i`, `-v`, `-x`), single vs. multi-file prefixes, and output formatting adhere to [README.md](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/pilot_grep_arm_b_1_att1_6et0bm0l/README.md).
3. **Audit Findings & Traps**:
   - **Performance Trap**: `pattern.lower()` is repeatedly invoked for every line in every file when `-i` is active. It should be precomputed once before file iteration.
   - **Algorithmic Redundancy**: `_line_body(raw_line)` is evaluated twice per matched line (inside `_line_matches` and again during result prefixing).
   - **Line Delimiter Edge Case**: `_line_body()` only checks `raw_line.endswith("\n")`. Slicing `[:-1]` leaves a trailing `\r` on CRLF (`\r\n`) lines, causing full-line matches (`-x`) to fail on CRLF inputs.
   - **Flag Tokenization Limitation**: `flags.split()` requires space-separated flags and will not recognize clustered flags (e.g. `"-nl"`).
4. **Off-by-One Audit**:
   - Line numbers are correctly 1-based via `enumerate(file_handle, start=1)`. No off-by-one errors found.

Neither [`grep.py`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/pilot_grep_arm_b_1_att1_6et0bm0l/grep.py) nor any test file was modified. Detailed recommendations and code fixes are available in [02_REVIEW.md](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/pilot_grep_arm_b_1_att1_6et0bm0l/02_REVIEW.md).
